quarterly_data.quarter: Analog Devices press release: Analog Devices to Acquire Alif Semiconductor, Adding an (09-09-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: ADI entered a definitive agreement to acquire Alif Semiconductor, maker of AI-native microcontrollers and fusion processors with a heterogeneous architecture for real-time sensor fusion, low-latency inference and on-device AI. Alif's silicon is already shipping in production, with design wins across leading consumer and industrial customers. ADI says the deal expands its addressable market across industrial, data center infrastructure, defense, energy, robotics, digital health and wearables by pairing Alif's digital platform with ADI's analog portfolio for 'Physical Intelligence' (edge AI). The transaction is expected to close before the end of calendar year 2026, subject to HSR clearance.
quarterly_data.figure: no specific figure (close expected before end of calendar 2026)
